div.h1: Build the future of automation with us
div.p: We are a team of engineers and specialists delivering total integrated automation across Industrial, Building and Terminal domains in Thailand. Grow your career with real projects, real technology and real mentoring.
We invest in people: structured onboarding, factory-certified training and a clear path from engineer to project leader.
Work on live industrial, building and terminal automation projects from day one.
Factory-certified product training and sponsorship for professional certificates.
Provident fund, group health insurance and annual health check-up for everyone.
Transparent career levels and annual performance review with real progression.
We are not hiring for this department at the moment, but we are always happy to receive a speculative application from talented people.
Send us your resume and we will contact you when a matching position opens.
Your information is used for recruitment purposes only.
